commit.subject: LU-10026 csdc: do not mix compressed and plain in niobuf
commit.message:
LU-10026 csdc: do not mix compressed and plain in niobuf

It is important to prevent placing
compresed and uncompressed chunks to the
same rnb, because rnb has only one set flags
for all chunks contained.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
DDN-bug-id: EX-7536
